_doc: The F22 suite. It declares `@bleavit/llm-handoff` and `@bleavit/verify` because it is the one place the platform package's two *projections* are checked against the shapes they project onto — `transportCapabilities` onto `chooseTransport`'s input, and `AttestationFinding` onto `SelfCheckFinding`. Neither edge exists in production, deliberately: `platform` is in `src/features/tx`'s 10 §10.2 reference set and neither of those packages is, so a production import would put a handoff package and the release-verifier one hop from the transaction unit. A test dependency carries no such edge and is what makes the two restatements bound rather than parallel.
name: @bleavit/platform-suite
